FavoriteQueryContract.Name: Resource
FavoriteQueryContract.QueryText:
SELECT r.Name, r.ResourceCode, rp.AssemblyName, rp.ClassName, r.*, rp.* FROM AUT.ResourceProp rp JOIN AUT.Resource r ON r.ResourceId = rp.ResourceId WHERE r.name like '%Taşıma yöntemi tanımlama%' or AssemblyName LIKE '%BOA.UI.CoreBanking.Teller.IntrabankMoneyTransferFromAccount%'
-- Tüm Ekranlar Select re.ResourceId,
re.ResourceCode,
re.ParentId,
re.Name,
re.TypeId,
re.IconPath,
re.SortId,
re.ChannelId,
ch.ChannelName,
re.IsActive,
rp.IsWorkflow,
ra.HasAccounting,
ra.HasSlip,
ra.HasCommission,
ar.HasRight,
ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM BOA.[ONE].[ResourceAction] ron WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ron.ResourceId = re.ResourceId), 0) IsOneAction,
(CASE WHEN rp.UIType = 4 OR ro.ResourceId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) IsOneResource,
(CASE WHEN rp.AssemblyName = 'BOA.UI.DWH.Report.Executer' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) IsReport,
rop.PageName,
ISNULL(tsc.AssemblyName, rp.AssemblyName) AssemblyName,
rp.ClassName, rp.ModuleCode,
wf.ResourceWorkFlow,
rm.FullPath,
CASE WHEN tsc.TaskCode IS NOT NULL OR rp.AssemblyName = 'BOA.Task.Executer' THEN 'Task'
WHEN rp.AssemblyName = 'BOA.UI.DWH.Report.Executer' THEN 'Report'
WHEN rp.AssemblyName like 'BOA.UI.DynamicFormGenerator.%' THEN 'Dynamic Screen'
WHEN LEN(RTRIM(re.ResourceCode)) > 4 THEN 'Screen'
END ResourceUsageType,
tsc.TaskId,
tsc.TaskCode,
tsc.TaskName,
tsc.TaskStatus,
rm.Parent1 Parent,
rm.Child1,
rm.Child2,
rm.Child3,
rm.Child4,
(LEN(rm.FullPath) - LEN(REPLACE(rm.FullPath, '>', '')) ) LevelCount,
rlm.ResourceRole
,[OneRoot]
,[OneParent]
,[OnePage]
---SElect COUNT(*)
-- INTO TMP.ResourceInfo
FROM BOA.AUT.Resource re WITH (NOLOCK)
LEFT JOIN BOA.COR.Channel ch WITH (NOLOCK) ON ch.ChannelId = re.ChannelId
LEFT JOIN BOA.AUT.ResourceProp rp WITH (NOLOCK) ON rp.ResourceId = re.ResourceId
LEFT JOIN BOA.AUT.MenuPath rm WITH (NOLOCK) ON rm.ResourceId = re.ResourceId
LEFT JOIN BOA.ONE.Resource ro WITH (NOLOCK) ON ro.ResourceId = re.ResourceId
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ropx.ResourceId, ropx.PageName
,(SElect Data FROM BOA.COR.fSplitStringToTable(ropx.PageName, '/') WHERE Id = 2) [OneRoot]
,(SElect Data FROM BOA.COR.fSplitStringToTable(ropx.PageName, '/') WHERE Id = 3) [OneParent]
, (SElect Data FROM BOA.COR.fSplitStringToTable(ropx.PageName, '/') WHERE Id = 4) [OnePage]
FROM BOA.ONE.ResourceProp ropx WITH (NOLOCK)
) rop ON rop.ResourceId = re.ResourceId
LEFT JOIN (SELECT reac.ResourceId, MAX(CONVERT(TINYINT, HasAccounting)) HasAccounting,
MAX(CONVERT(TINYINT, HasSlip)) HasSlip, MAX(CONVERT(TINYINT, HasCommission)) HasCommission
FROM BOA.AUT.ResourceAction reac WITH (NOLOCK)
GROUP BY reac.ResourceId
) ra ON ra.ResourceId = re.ResourceId
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ars.ResourceId, MAX(CASE WHEN ars.IsAllow = 1 AND ars.BitMask > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) HasRight
FROM BOA.AUT.AccessRight ars WITH (NOLOCK)
GROUP BY ars.ResourceId
) ar ON ar.ResourceId = re.ResourceId
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT rf.ResourceCode, STUFF( (SELECT CONCAT(', ', wff.FlowID, ' - ', wff.Name)
FROM BOA.WFL.ResourceFlow rfs WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN BOA.WFL.Flow wff WITH (NOLOCK) ON rfs.FlowId = wff.FlowID
WHERE rfs.ResourceCode = rf.ResourceCode
FOR XML PATH(''),TYPE).value('text()[1]','nvarchar(max)'),1, 2,N'') ResourceWorkFlow
FROM BOA.WFL.ResourceFlow rf WITH (NOLOCK)
--WHERE rf.ResourceCode = 'IDRTSATSTA'
GROUP BY rf.ResourceCode
) wf ON wf.ResourceCode = re.ResourceCode
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT td.ResourceId, td.TaskId, td.Name TaskName, td.Status TaskStatus, td.TaskCode,
MAX(ISNULL(tae.AssemblyName, reg.AssemblyName)) AssemblyName
FROM BOA.TSC.TaskDefinition td WITH(NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN BOA.TSC.TaskDefinitionDetail tdd WITH(NOLOCK) ON td.TaskId = tdd.TaskId
INNER JOIN BOA.TSC.TaskAction ta WITH(NOLOCK) ON ta.TaskDetailId = tdd.TaskDefinitionDetailId
LEFT JOIN BOA.TSC.TaskActionCallBOAEOD tae WITH(NOLOCK) ON tae.TaskDetailId = tdd.TaskDefinitionDetailId AND ta.ItemNumber = tae.ItemNumber
LEFT JOIN BOA.TSC.TaskActionCallBOARequest tbr WITH(NOLOCK) ON tbr.TaskDetailId = tdd.TaskDefinitionDetailId AND ta.ItemNumber = tbr.ItemNumber
LEFT JOIN BOA.COR.Registry reg WITH(NOLOCK) ON reg.RegistryID = tbr.RegistryId
WHERE tdd.IsActive = 1
GROUP BY td.ResourceId, td.TaskId, td.Name, td.Status, td.TaskCode
) tsc ON tsc.ResourceId = re.ResourceId
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT rrlx.ResourceId, STUFF( (SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(', ', CASE WHEN rl.RoleId IN (2, 12) THEN 'Bireysel'
WHEN rl.IsCorporate = 1 AND rl.RoleId <= 16 THEN 'Kurumsal'
END)
FROM BOAWeb.INT.RoleResource rrl WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN BOAWeb.INT.[Role] rl WITH (NOLOCK) ON rrl.RoleId = rl.RoleId
WHERE rrl.ResourceId = rrlx.ResourceId
FOR XML PATH(''),TYPE).value('text()[1]','nvarchar(max)'),1, 2,N'') ResourceRole
FROM BOAWeb.INT.RoleResource rrlx WITH (NOLOCK)
GROUP BY rrlx.ResourceId
) rlm ON rlm.ResourceId = re.ResourceId where re.IsActive = 1 ORDER BY re.ParentId, re.SortId, re.Name

-- SP'lerde SELECT s.name AS SchemaName, p.name FROM sys.procedures p JOIN sys.schemas s ON p.schema_id = s.schema_id WHERE Object_definition(p.object_id) LIKE '%EffectivePartnerExperience%'
-- View SELECT s.name AS SchemaName, p.name, Object_definition(p.object_id) FROM sys.all_views p JOIN sys.schemas s ON p.schema_id = s.schema_id WHERE Object_definition(p.object_id) LIKE '%aa%'
-- Tablolarda SELECT s.name AS SchemaName, c.name AS'ColumnName', t.name AS'TableName' FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.tables t ON c.object_id =t.object_id JOIN sys.schemas s ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id WHERE c.name LIKE'%ReviseReasonId%' ORDER BY TableName, ColumnName;
-- Tablo kolon karşılaştırma SELECT ct.name, * FROM SYS.OBJECTS ot JOIN SYS.OBJECTS os ON os.schema_id = 189 AND os.name='DailyFlowDeclaration'
FULL OUTER JOIN SYS.COLUMNS ct ON ct.object_id = ot.object_id FULL OUTER JOIN SYS.COLUMNS cs ON cs.object_id = os.object_id AND cs.name = ct.name WHERE ot.schema_id = 189 AND ot.name='DailyFlowDeclaration_TEMP' AND (ct.column_id is null OR cs.column_id is null OR ct.system_type_id <> cs.system_type_id OR ct.is_nullable <> cs.is_nullable OR ct.is_identity <> cs.is_identity OR ct.user_type_id <> cs.user_type_id OR ct.max_length <> cs.max_length)

FavoriteQueryContract.Name: Yetkiler
FavoriteQueryContract.QueryText:
Çalışma grubu bazlı: BOA.[AUT].[fActionIdListByBitmask] Tablo: select * from AUT.AccessRight
Bir ekrana bağlı olarak bir aksiyon için accesspoint üzerinden bir kişide yetki var mı kontrolü yapar: select * from aut.AccessRight ar where ar.AccessPointId in (select AccessPointId from aut.fAccessPointIdListByUserId(127)) and ar.ResourceId=402 and exists(SELECT 1 FROM BOA.[AUT].[fActionIdListByBitmask](ar.BitMask) f where f.ActionId = 52)
Yetki silme UPDATE a SET a.Bitmask = a.Bitmask - POWER(CAST(2 AS BIGINT), ra.ActionId - 1) ---SELECT * FROM BOA.AUT.AccessRight a WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN BOA.AUT.Resource re WITH (NOLOCK) ON re.ResourceId = a.ResourceId INNER JOIN @ResourceAction ra ON re.ResourceCode = ra.ResourceCode WHERE AccessPointId = @AccessPointId AND EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM BOA.[AUT].[fActionIdListByBitmask](a.Bitmask) f WHERE f.ActionId = ra.ActionId) AND re.IsActive = 1
Yetki kaldırma cursor ile DECLARE @AccessPointId INT, @ResourceId INT, @IsAllow BIT, @ActiveFrom SMALLDATETIME, @ActiveTo SMALLDATETIME, @ActionId INT, @Bitmask BIGINT, @BitmaskNew BIGINT
DECLARE contact_cursor CURSOR FOR select a.AccessPointId, a.ResourceId, a.IsAllow, a.ActiveFrom, a.ActiveTo, ra.ActionId, a.Bitmask, a.Bitmask - POWER(CAST(2 AS BIGINT), ra.ActionId - 1) as BitmaskNew FROM BOA.AUT.AccessRight a WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN BOA.AUT.Resource re WITH (NOLOCK) ON re.ResourceId = a.ResourceId INNER JOIN AUT.ResourceAction ra ON ra.ResourceId = re.ResourceId and ra.ActionId in (40, 10, 6, 8, 14, 15, 57, 9, 4, 7, 50, 16) WHERE EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM BOA.[AUT].[fActionIdListByBitmask](a.Bitmask) f WHERE f.ActionId = ra.ActionId) AND re.IsActive = 1 and re.ResourceId = 12716
OPEN contact_cursor;
-- Perform the first fetch. FETCH NEXT FROM contact_cursor INTO @AccessPointId, @ResourceId, @IsAllow, @ActiveFrom, @ActiveTo, @ActionId, @Bitmask, @BitmaskNew
-- Check @@FETCH_STATUS to see if there are any more rows to fetch. WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN UPDATE AUT.AccessRight SET BitMask = @BitmaskNew where AccessPointId=@AccessPointId and ResourceId=@ResourceId and IsAllow=@IsAllow and ActiveFrom=@ActiveFrom and ActiveTo=@ActiveTo
FETCH NEXT FROM contact_cursor INTO @AccessPointId, @ResourceId, @IsAllow, @ActiveFrom, @ActiveTo, @ActionId, @Bitmask, @BitmaskNew END
CLOSE contact_cursor; DEALLOCATE contact_cursor; GO

'YourTRQRPurchaseIsFailedWithFast', 'YourTRQRPurchaseIsSucceededWithFast') and m.MessagingGroupId=716 --UNION ALL --select 'UNION ALL SELECT '''+m.PropertyName+''' AS PropertyName, '''+REPLACE(d.Description, '''', '''''')+''' AS Description, '+CAST(d.LanguageId as VARCHAR)+' AS LanguageId, '+cast(m.MessagingGroupId as varchar)+' AS MessagingGroupId' from cor.messagingdetail d join cor.messaging m on m.code=d.code where m.PropertyName IN ('FASTBalance', 'FromEFTToFAST', 'FromFASTToEFT', 'OutgoingFASTExtraRecord', 'OutgoingFASTMissingRecord') and m.MessagingGroupId=46 --UNION ALL --select 'UNION ALL SELECT '''+m.PropertyName+''' AS PropertyName, '''+REPLACE(d.Description, '''', '''''')+''' AS Description, '+CAST(d.LanguageId as VARCHAR)+' AS LanguageId, '+cast(m.MessagingGroupId as varchar)+' AS MessagingGroupId' from cor.messagingdetail d join cor.messaging m on m.code=d.code where m.PropertyName IN ('DepositAndWithdrawalFasterAtATM', 'DepositAndWithdrawalFasterAtATMDetail') and m.MessagingGroupId=677 DECLARE @PropertyName VARCHAR(500), @Description NVARCHAR(MAX), @LanguageId INT, @MessagingGroupId INT
DECLARE messaging_cursor CURSOR FOR SELECT 'CustomerIdMustBeGreaterThanZero' AS PropertyName, 'Müşteri numarası boş olamaz.' AS Description, 1 AS LanguageId, 19 AS MessagingGroupId UNION ALL SELECT 'CustomerIdMustBeGreaterThanZero' AS PropertyName, 'Cutomer id must be greater than zero.' AS Description, 2 AS LanguageId, 19 AS MessagingGroupId UNION ALL SELECT 'SMEAccountConstraintNotFound' AS PropertyName, '{0} numaralı başvuru için kısıt numarası bulunamadı.' AS Description, 1 AS LanguageId, 19 AS MessagingGroupId UNION ALL SELECT 'SMEAccountConstraintStatusError' AS PropertyName, '{0} nolu başvuru için kısıt devam etmektedir.' AS Description, 1 AS LanguageId, 19 AS MessagingGroupId UNION ALL SELECT 'YRBCustomerIdWarning' AS PropertyName, 'Lütfen müşteri numarasını giriniz.' AS Description, 1 AS LanguageId, 19 AS MessagingGroupId UNION ALL SELECT 'YRBCustomerIdWarning' AS PropertyName, 'Please enter the customer number.' AS Description, 2 AS LanguageId, 19 AS MessagingGroupId UNION ALL SELECT 'YrbOldConstraintCouldNotBeFetched' AS PropertyName, 'Hesap üzerindeki önceki kısıt bilgisi getirilemedi.' AS Description, 1 AS LanguageId, 19 AS MessagingGroupId UNION ALL SELECT 'YrbVideoCallAccountConstraintAlertText' AS PropertyName, 'Uzaktan Müşteri Edinimi Hesap Kısıtı' AS Description, 1 AS LanguageId, 19 AS MessagingGroupId UNION ALL SELECT 'YrbVideoCallAccountConstraintDescription' AS PropertyName, 'Uzaktan Müşteri Edinimi Hesap Kısıtı' AS Description, 1 AS LanguageId, 19 AS MessagingGroupId UNION ALL SELECT 'CustomerNotFoundMsg' AS PropertyName, 'Müşteri bulunamadı.' AS Description, 1 AS LanguageId, 44 AS MessagingGroupId UNION ALL SELECT 'ParameterNotFoundError' AS PropertyName, 'Parametre bulunamadı.' AS Description, 1 AS LanguageId, 44 AS MessagingGroupId UNION ALL SELECT 'RoleUpdateInvalidUserRoleMessage' AS PropertyName, 'Bireysel müşteri numarası giriniz.' AS Description, 1 AS LanguageId, 44 AS MessagingGroupId UNION ALL SELECT 'UserRoleInfoNotFound' AS PropertyName, 'Kullanıcı Rol Bilgisi Bulunamadı' AS Description, 1 AS LanguageId, 44 AS MessagingGroupId UNION ALL SELECT 'UserRoleInfoNotFound' AS PropertyName, 'User Role Information Is Not Found' AS Description, 2 AS LanguageId, 44 AS MessagingGroupId
OPEN messaging_cursor
FETCH NEXT FROM messaging_cursor INTO @PropertyName, @Description, @LanguageId, @MessagingGroupId
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM COR.Messaging WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE MessagingGroupId=@MessagingGroupId AND PropertyName = @PropertyName) BEGIN INSERT INTO BOA.COR.Messaging (MessagingGroupId, PropertyName, Severity, UserName, HostName, SystemDate, HostIP) VALUES (@MessagingGroupId, @PropertyName, 0, 'arch', 'arch_comp', GETDATE(), 'ip') END
DECLARE @Code INT SELECT @Code = Code FROM BOA.COR.Messaging WHERE PropertyName = @PropertyName AND MessagingGroupId = @MessagingGroupId
-- COR.MessagingDetail ekleniyor\güncelleniyor IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM COR.MessagingDetail WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE Code = @Code AND LanguageId = @LanguageId) BEGIN INSERT INTO BOA.COR.MessagingDetail (Code, LanguageId, Description, SystemDate) VALUES(@Code, @LanguageId, @Description, GETDATE()) END ELSE BEGIN UPDATE COR.MessagingDetail SET Description = @Description WHERE Code = @Code AND LanguageId = @LanguageId END
FETCH NEXT FROM messaging_cursor INTO @PropertyName, @Description, @LanguageId, @MessagingGroupId END CLOSE messaging_cursor; DEALLOCATE messaging_cursor;
UPDATE COR.MessagingGroup SET Version = Version + 1 WHERE MessagingGroupId IN (19, 44)
